title: Associate Professor - Causal Inference
employer: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey
description:
The Department of Economics of the School of Arts and Sciences at Rutgers University-New Brunswick invites applications for a tenure-track Associate Professor position to start Fall 2027.  The position involves teaching undergraduate and graduate courses in the field of applied microeconometrics, research activity and university service.

We welcome candidates whose research focuses on econometric methods used for causal inference in applied microeconomics. The successful candidate must have a Ph.D. in Economics or related field. We welcome applicants with the following: distinguished record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated by publications in leading academic journals; an active research agenda; and a strong record of teaching excellence and mentorship at the undergraduate and/or graduate levels. Salary is competitive. Advanced assistant professor candidates will also be considered.

Located in New Jersey, Rutgers University is a premiere, Research 1, public land grant institution that reflects the broad spectrum of backgrounds in the state. The School of Arts and Sciences, the largest and most comprehensive school at Rutgers University, is especially interested in candidates who can advance the goals and values expressed in the SAS Strategic Plan. Applicants are encouraged to include in their cover letter information about how they will further our mission of excellence. Rutgers University is an equal opportunity employer.  As an institution, we encourage all qualified applicants to apply.

To apply: Candidates should upload (a) a cover letter, (b) curriculum vitae, (c) research statement, (d) teaching statement with evaluations (if any), (e) up to three research papers, and (f) the names of three confidential recommendation letter writers at  https://jobs.rutgers.edu/postings/282374. Contact Janet Budge (budge@economics.rutgers.edu) with questions. Review of applications will begin November 16.
